scope: Future linked-list contract sketch; insertion, deletion and retargeting on existing core with graph/tree boundaries; no implementation or publication

conclusion.boundedTo: Finite acyclic singly linked lists with immutable valid complete snapshots, stable node/next-slot IDs, null targets and atomic insertion/deletion/reordering
conclusion.stagingBoundary: Detached allocated nodes and partial pointer operations are separate application-owned working State, not valid list/tree snapshots or a promised new staging API
conclusion.graphBoundary: Per-snapshot graph mapping does not widen graph fixed-topology traces
conclusion.treeBoundary: Only complete valid chains map to a rooted single-child tree; raw working arenas may not

requirements.model: Unique IDs; headId plus nextId fields are authoritative; reach every node once from head to null; empty/singleton valid; no cycles/dangling/shared-successor/unreachable members
requirements.identity: Stable node IDs independent of equal values/order; next pointer identity is owner+next slot, independent of target; namespaced scene IDs
requirements.null: A nullable pointer target is application data, not a fake node or a Scene phase; a projected null slot can remain an update across target changes
requirements.transitions: Resolve both old/current pointer endpoint generations through Scene.get, including removed nodes and zero-presence transitions; guard null
requirements.validation: Future list module validates atomically before commit; generic Scene deliberately has no list invariant checks
requirements.projection: Immutable pure endpoint projection; layout/routing/null markers and viewport transformations are renderer/application concerns
requirements.results: Persistent chain/marks/results in State; rewind restores retained snapshots, not reverse pointer assignments
requirements.ownership: Copied/frozen module-owned records; app payload immutable and cloneable by caller; dispose follows existing iterator/session ownership, not manual memory deallocation
requirements.moduleBoundary: Headless DOM-free model; exact entry/types/trace/errors/staging/rendering/graph-tree adapters require a separate API contract

runtimeProbe.scope: Current core API with handwritten application list/staging snapshots and scenes; no list implementation or model validation
